judge.rationale: The candidate implementation was stopped mid-progress, leaving major requirements unimplemented. In `ToolRegistry`, schemas for function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` are erroneously compiled only once at `register` time rather than resolved per call and cached in a `WeakMap`, and validation failures are not logged at all (`log.warn`). Furthermore, the required one-line doc comment on `execute` is missing, `registry.test.ts` contains only one of the required unit tests, `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` was not updated, and none of the documentation files (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were updated. Finally, the candidate left behind a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file and a non-standard `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file, while leaving statements in `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` unlinked and status as 'In Progress'.
